forms.name: Review an entry
forms.title: [Review]
forms.description: Tell the editors whether an entry makes sense, reads well and carries the right labels.

fields.label: Entry
fields.description: The entry's identifier, shown on its page, for example IR-028.

fields.label: Your review
fields.description: What works, what does not, and why.

fields.label: Suggested wording
fields.description: Wording you would like to read instead, if any.

fields.label: Corrections
fields.description: Anything wrong, missing or out of date: a fact, figure, date, product or source, with a link to your evidence.

fields.label: Interests to declare
fields.description: Any tie to a vendor, product or organisation named in this entry or in your sources. Write None if there is nothing to declare.

fields.label: Credit
fields.description: Published contributions credit their contributor by name unless you choose otherwise.

fields.label: Name to credit
fields.description: Leave empty to use your name on the list of people.

fields.label: Prepared by an AI assistant
fields.description: Filled in when an AI assistant prepared this contribution with The Intelligence Radar's MCP server. Leave it as it is.

fields.label: Terms
options: I agree that my contribution is published under CC BY 4.0, with credit as I chose above.
I follow the code of conduct in this repository.
